C. <u>Noise Levels</u>: The Agency believes that mo appreciable incease in noise levels are likely to result from the AFES for MY 1979. The manufacturers do not plan large scale reductions in sound absorption materials or weight reduction means. Also, the manufacturers plan only very limited application of diesel engines in MY 1979.
There is a possibility that noise levels will increase slightly due to manufacturers' plans to substitute 6 cylinder and smaller V-8 engines for larger V-8 engines. Inquiries have been made to determine if data were available to answer the noise problem associated with this shift.
Research is underway at DOT and EPA to determine the relation of engine size to noise. Presently, there is little data of substantive value to provide a clear insight into the problem. Most data has been collected
